info.title: GreenGateway MCP Client Configuration Templates Admin API
info.description: Credential-free MCP client configuration templates (issue #242, ADR-0008 "MCP client templates"). The default path is shown with ADMIN_PREFIX=/admin; replace /admin with the configured ADMIN_PREFIX while retaining the /v1 API prefix. With ADMIN_LISTEN_ADDR set the route is served on the admin listener only. Every template names the gateway's own MCP endpoint, which the gateway computes from GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL exactly as its OAuth protected-resource metadata computes the resource identifier; no request header, forwarding header, or query parameter can change it, and no template points at an upstream Connection. An OAuth template holds only that URL. A token template names the environment variable GREENGATEWAY_MCP_TOKEN in the client's interpolation syntax and never holds a token. Minting a service token remains POST /v1{ADMIN_PREFIX}/tokens under admin:tokens:write and its delegation rules.

servers.description: The active GreenGateway listener: the admin listener when ADMIN_LISTEN_ADDR is set, otherwise the data listener.

get.summary: Get credential-free MCP client configuration templates
get.description: Requires admin:mcp:clients:read, which is neither admin:config:read nor a token permission, and a configured POLICY_FILE. Under a default-deny policy, route GET /v1{ADMIN_PREFIX}/mcp with that permission. Returns, for generic Streamable HTTP, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code, an OAuth template when the protected-resource metadata advertises an authorization server and a token template for every client but Claude Desktop. Read-only; nothing is audited on success, and a denial is audited as authz.denied like every admin route.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The server entry name the JSON templates use (default greengateway). Any other query parameter, a repeated name, or a name outside this grammar is refused with 400 and is never echoed.

200.description: The templates. The shared reader in the gateway-config crate, which ggctl mcp-config uses, accepts the document only when every template is exactly what its version renders.

400.description: The query is not at most one valid name. Nothing was rendered.

404.description: No POLICY_FILE is configured, so no admin read route is served.

409.description: The gateway has no GATEWAY_PUBLIC_URL (public_url_not_configured), or the MCP endpoint derived from it holds $, {, } or \, which client configuration files interpolate or escape, or is longer than 16 KiB (public_url_not_templatable). The gateway never guesses a URL from the request. Nothing was rendered.

bearerAuth.description: A validated bearer JWT or ggw_ service token.

cookieAuth.name: session
cookieAuth.description: The default session cookie. AUTH_COOKIE_NAME changes this name. The route is a read, so no CSRF token is needed.

AdminError.description: Stable sanitized error body: unauthorized (401) or forbidden (403).

error.description: Fixed text; never a value from the request or the configuration.
